title: The CA-ACF2 GSO OPTS record value must be properly specified.
check_content:
From the ACF Command enter:
SET CONTROL(GSO)
LIST OPTS

If the GSO OPTS record values conform to the following requirements, this is not a finding.

BLPLOG
NOCMDREC
CONSOLE(NOROLL)
CPUTIME(LOCAL)
DATE(MDY)
NODDB
DFTLID()
DFTSTC()
INFOLIST(none | AUDIT | SECURITY | SECURITY, AUDIT)
JOBCK
MAXVIO(10)
NOTIFY
RPTSCOPE
SHRDASD
STAMPSMF
STC
TAPEDSN
TEMPDSN
NOUADS
NOVTAMOPEN
fixtext:
Define the global options available to the system.

BLPLOG
NOCMDREC
CONSOLE(NOROLL)
CPUTIME(LOCAL)
DATE(MDY)
NODDB
DFTLID()
DFTSTC()
INFOLIST(none | AUDIT | SECURITY | SECURITY, AUDIT)
JOBCK
MAXVIO(10)
NOTIFY
RPTSCOPE
SHRDASD
STAMPSMF
STC
TAPEDSN
TEMPDSN
NOUADS
NOVTAMOPEN

Example:
SET C(GSO)
INSERT OPTS BLPLOG NOCMDREC CONSOLE(NOROLL) CPUTIME(LOCAL) DATE(MDY) NODDB DFTLID() DFTSTC() INFOLIST(SECURITY, AUDIT) JOBCK MAXVIO(10)
MODE(ABORT) NOTIFY RPTSCOPE SHRDASD STAMPSMF STC TAPEDSN TEMPDSN NOUADS NOVTAMOPEN

F ACF2,REFRESH(OPTS)
